newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singmarine wins S$28 mln building deal.
newsitem.headline: Singmarine wins S$28 mln building deal.

text.p: Keppel Corp's Singmarine Industries Ltd said on Thursday its subsidiary won a Singapore $28 million contract to build a self-loading coal/oil barge and two pusher tugs.
The contract, won by Singmarine Dockyard and Engineering Pte Ltd (Singmarine Dockyard), was awarded by Indonesia's PT Freeport, Singmarine said in a statement.
The barge will be of 8,000 deadweights tonne while the two pusher tugs will have a bollard pull of 65 tonnes.

The barge and one of the tugs were scheduled for delivery in the fourth quarter 1997 while the second tug wwould be delivered in the first quarter of 1998. The vessels would be used at Amamapare, Indonesia.
PT Freeport operates a mining operation in Irian Jaya, Indonesia.
